title: 日本ダービーの後に・疲弊の理由

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black has managed to enter and run the Japanese Derby, but she's hit with extreme fatigue after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At 2,400 meters, it's a tough G1 race. Doubts about her distance aptitude start to rise after the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho, the last of the Classic Triple Crown races, is even longer than today's race. A new problem has reared its ugly head.
